technical_and_design_decisions: Kafka Pipeline (U1): Implement Spring XD stream definitions and custom processing modules demonstrating log aggregation, code reuse, and reliable reprocessing via Kafka messaging.

Sqoop & JDBC-HDFS Samples (U2, U7): Construct Spring XD batch job configurations and reference scripts for bidirectional data transfer between relational databases and HDFS using Sqoop and native JDBC source/sink.
Gradle Build Modernization (U3): Clean up Gradle documentation scripts, delete obsolete 'pushGeneratedDocs' task, and remove legacy URL/link rewriting logic.
Storm & Spark Streaming Comparisons (U4, U5): Build comparative Spring XD stream implementations alongside Apache Storm and Spark Streaming pattern documentation to guide migration/integration.
Smart Grid Demo Port (U6): Port source code, configurations, and stream definitions from the s1-2014 Smart Grid demo into the standard Spring XD samples repository structure.
File Sink Enhancement (U8): Add the '--nameExpression' configuration option to the File Sink module definition, binding it to the underlying Spring Integration 'filename-generator-expression'.
assumptions: Development environment includes access to local or virtualized clusters for Hadoop, HDFS, Kafka, Sqoop, Spark, and Storm for integration testing.
The developer has strong working knowledge of Spring XD, Spring Integration, Gradle, Java 17+, and JVM ecosystem tools.
All work is executed by a single developer handling specification design, coding, sample verification, and build updates.

activities.activity_description: Create sample applications and stream definitions utilizing Kafka as a message bus in Spring XD, demonstrating log aggregation, Lambda architecture concepts, code decoupling, and reliable reprocessing.

activities.activity_name: Develop Sqoop and JDBC to HDFS Batch Samples (U2, U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement batch job samples demonstrating data transfer between JDBC sources and HDFS (and vice versa) using Apache Sqoop and Spring XD batch capabilities.
Modify Gradle build scripts to update documentation generation, remove the pushGeneratedDocs task, and strip unnecessary link rewriting rules.

activities.activity_name: Develop Storm and Spark Streaming Comparison Examples (U4, U5)
activities.activity_description: Create side-by-side stream implementation examples and comparative documentation comparing Spring XD streams against Apache Storm and Apache Spark Streaming patterns.

activities.activity_name: Port Smart Grid Demo to Spring XD Samples Repo (U6)
activities.activity_description: Refactor and port the 2014 Smart Grid demonstration code into the current Spring XD samples repository structure and verify execution.
Update the File Sink module options to accept --nameExpression and map it directly to filename-generator-expression, including module unit test updates.
End-to-end integration testing of all samples, verifying Gradle build execution, stream deployments, and documentation building.
